verses.original: וַיִּתְחַזֵּ֛ק שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בֶן־ דָּוִ֖יד עַל־ מַלְכוּת֑וֹ וַיהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהָיו֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וַֽיְגַדְּלֵ֖הוּ לְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·ḥaz·zêq šə·lō·mōh ḇen- dā·wîḏ ‘al- mal·ḵū·ṯōw Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw ‘im·mōw way·ḡad·də·lê·hū lə·mā·‘ə·lāh
verses.literal: Now Solomon son of David established himself securely over his kingdom and the LORD his God was with him and highly exalted him
verses.literalPt: SALOMÃO, filho de Davi, fortaleceu-se no seu reino; e o SENHOR seu Deus era com ele, e o engrandeceu sobremaneira.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה לְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל לְשָׂרֵי֩ הָאֲלָפִ֨ים וְהַמֵּא֜וֹת וְלַשֹּֽׁפְטִ֗ים וּלְכֹ֛ל נָשִׂ֥יא לְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל רָאשֵׁ֥י הָאָבֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·lō·mōh lə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl lə·śā·rê hā·’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·ham·mê·’ō·wṯ wə·laš·šō·p̄ə·ṭîm ū·lə·ḵōl nā·śî lə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then Solomon spoke to all Israel to the commanders of thousands and of hundreds to the judges and to every leader in all Israel the heads of the families
verses.literalPt: E falou Salomão a todo o Israel, aos capitães de mil e de cem, aos juízes e a todos os governadores em todo o Israel, chefes das famílias.

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכ֗וּ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ וְכָל־ הַקָּהָ֣ל עִמּ֔וֹ לַבָּמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּגִבְע֑וֹן כִּי־ שָׁ֣ם הָיָ֗ה אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה מֹשֶׁ֥ה עֶֽבֶד־ יְהוָ֖ה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·lə·ḵū šə·lō·mōh wə·ḵāl haq·qā·hāl ‘im·mōw lab·bā·māh ’ă·šer bə·ḡiḇ·‘ō·wn kî- šām hā·yāh ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh mō·šeh ‘e·ḇeḏ- Yah·weh bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: And Solomon and the whole assembly went to the high place at Gibeon because it was the location of God’s Tent of Meeting which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: E foi Salomão, e toda a congregação com ele, ao alto que estava em Gibeom, porque ali estava a tenda da congregação de Deus, que Moisés, servo do SENHOR, tinha feito no deserto.

verses.original: אֲבָ֗ל אֲר֤וֹן הָאֱלֹהִים֙ הֶעֱלָ֤ה דָוִיד֙ מִקִּרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים בַּֽהֵכִ֥ין ל֖וֹ דָּוִ֑יד כִּ֧י נָֽטָה־ ל֛וֹ אֹ֖הֶל בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇāl ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm he·‘ĕ·lāh ḏā·wîḏ miq·qir·yaṯ yə·‘ā·rîm ba·hê·ḵîn lōw dā·wîḏ kî nā·ṭāh- lōw ’ō·hel bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Now David had brought the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim to the place he had prepared for it because he had pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Mas Davi tinha feito subir a arca de Deus de Quiriate-Jearim ao lugar que lhe preparara; porque lhe tinha armado uma tenda em Jerusalém.

verses.original: וּמִזְבַּ֣ח הַנְּחֹ֗שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ בְּצַלְאֵל֙ בֶּן־ אוּרִ֣י בֶן־ ח֔וּר שָׂ֕ם לִפְנֵ֖י מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּדְרְשֵׁ֥הוּ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה וְהַקָּהָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miz·baḥ han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh bə·ṣal·’êl ben- ’ū·rî ḇen- ḥūr śām lip̄·nê miš·kan Yah·weh way·yiḏ·rə·šê·hū šə·lō·mōh wə·haq·qā·hāl
verses.literal: But the bronze altar made by Bezalel son of Uri the son of Hur was in Gibeon before the tabernacle of the LORD So Solomon and the assembly inquired of Him there
verses.literalPt: Também o altar de cobre que tinha feito Bezaleel, filho de Uri, filho de Hur, estava ali diante do tabernáculo do SENHOR; e Salomão e a congregação o buscavam.

verses.original: וַיַּעַל֩ שְׁלֹמֹ֨ה שָׁ֜ם עַל־ מִזְבַּ֤ח הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיַּ֧עַל עָלָ֛יו עֹל֖וֹת אָֽלֶף׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al šə·lō·mōh šām ‘al- miz·baḥ han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ă·šer lə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ way·ya·‘al ‘ā·lāw ‘ō·lō·wṯ ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: Solomon offered sacrifices there before the LORD on the bronze altar at the Tent of Meeting where he offered a thousand burnt offerings
verses.literalPt: E Salomão ofereceu ali sacrifícios perante o SENHOR, sobre o altar de cobre que estava na tenda da congregação; e ofereceu sobre ele mil holocaustos.

verses.original: בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַה֔וּא נִרְאָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים לִשְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ שְׁאַ֖ל מָ֥ה אֶתֶּן־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: bal·lay·lāh ha·hū nir·’āh ’ĕ·lō·hîm liš·lō·mōh way·yō·mer lōw šə·’al māh ’et·ten- lāḵ
verses.literal: That night God appeared to Solomon and said Ask and I will give it to you
verses.literalPt: Naquela mesma noite Deus apareceu a Salomão, e disse-lhe: Pede o que queres que eu te dê.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים אַתָּ֗ה עָשִׂ֛יתָ עִם־ דָּוִ֥יד אָבִ֖י חֶ֣סֶד גָּד֑וֹל וְהִמְלַכְתַּ֖נִי תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·lō·mōh lê·lō·hîm ’at·tāh ‘ā·śî·ṯā ‘im- dā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇî ḥe·seḏ gā·ḏō·wl wə·him·laḵ·ta·nî taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: Solomon replied to God You have shown much loving devotion to my father David and You have made me king in his place
verses.literalPt: E Salomão disse a Deus: Tu usaste de grande benignidade com meu pai Davi, e a mim me fizeste rei em seu lugar.

verses.original: עַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים יֵֽאָמֵן֙ דְּבָ֣רְךָ֔ עִ֖ם דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑י כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ הִמְלַכְתַּ֔נִי עַל־ עַ֕ם רַ֖ב כַּעֲפַ֥ר הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm yê·’ā·mên də·ḇā·rə·ḵā ‘im dā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇî kî ’at·tāh him·laḵ·ta·nî ‘al- ‘am raḇ ka·‘ă·p̄ar hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Now O LORD God let Your promise to my father David be fulfilled For You have made me king over a people as numerous as the dust of the earth
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, ó SENHOR Deus, confirme-se a tua palavra, dada a meu pai Davi; porque tu me fizeste reinar sobre um povo numeroso como o pó da terra.

verses.original: עַתָּ֗ה חָכְמָ֤ה וּמַדָּע֙ תֶּן־ לִ֔י וְאֵֽצְאָ֛ה לִפְנֵ֥י הָֽעָם־ הַזֶּ֖ה וְאָב֑וֹאָה כִּֽי־ מִ֣י יִשְׁפֹּ֔ט אֶת־ עַמְּךָ֥ הַזֶּ֖ה הַגָּדֽוֹל׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh ḥāḵ·māh ū·mad·dā‘ ten- lî wə·’ê·ṣə·’āh lip̄·nê hā·‘ām- haz·zeh wə·’ā·ḇō·w·’āh kî- mî yiš·pōṭ ’eṯ- ‘am·mə·ḵā haz·zeh hag·gā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: Now grant me wisdom and knowledge so that I may lead . . . . . . this people For who is able to govern this great people of Yours
verses.literalPt: Dá-me, pois, agora, sabedoria e conhecimento, para que possa sair e entrar perante este povo; pois quem poderia julgar a este tão grande povo?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר־ אֱלֹהִ֣ים׀ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֡ה יַ֣עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיְתָ֨ה זֹ֜את עִם־ לְבָבֶ֗ךָ וְלֹֽא־ שָׁ֠אַלְתָּ עֹ֣שֶׁר נְכָסִ֤ים וְכָבוֹד֙ וְאֵת֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ שֹׂנְאֶ֔יךָ וְגַם־ יָמִ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים לֹ֣א שָׁאָ֑לְתָּ וַתִּֽשְׁאַל־ לְךָ֙ חָכְמָ֣ה וּמַדָּ֔ע אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּשְׁפּוֹט֙ אֶת־ עַמִּ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִמְלַכְתִּ֖יךָ עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer- ’ĕ·lō·hîm liš·lō·mōh ya·‘an ’ă·šer hā·yə·ṯāh zōṯ ‘im- lə·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā wə·lō·šā- šā·ʾal·tā ‘ō·šer nə·ḵā·sîm wə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ wə·’êṯ ne·p̄eš śō·nə·’e·ḵā wə·ḡam- yā·mîm rab·bîm lō šā·’ā·lə·tā wat·tiš·’al- lə·ḵā ḥāḵ·māh ū·mad·dā‘ ’ă·šer tiš·pō·wṭ ’eṯ- ‘am·mî ’ă·šer him·laḵ·tî·ḵā ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: God said to Solomon Since this was in your heart instead of requesting riches or wealth or honor for yourself or death for your enemies and since you have not even requested long life but have asked for wisdom and knowledge to govern My people over whom I have made you king
verses.literalPt: Então Deus disse a Salomão: Porquanto houve isto no teu coração, e não pediste riquezas, bens, ou honra, nem a morte dos que te odeiam, nem tampouco pediste muitos dias de vida, mas pediste para ti sabedoria e conhecimento, para poderes julgar a meu povo, sobre o qual te constituí rei,

verses.original: הַֽחָכְמָ֥ה וְהַמַּדָּ֖ע נָת֣וּן לָ֑ךְ וְעֹ֨שֶׁר וּנְכָסִ֤ים וְכָבוֹד֙ אֶתֶּן־ לָ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ לֹא־ הָ֣יָה כֵ֗ן לַמְּלָכִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְאַחֲרֶ֖יךָ לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה־ כֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥā·ḵə·māh wə·ham·mad·dā‘ nā·ṯūn lāḵ wə·‘ō·šer ū·nə·ḵā·sîm wə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ ’et·ten- lāḵ ’ă·šer lō- hā·yāh ḵên lam·mə·lā·ḵîm ’ă·šer lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·’a·ḥă·re·ḵā lō yih·yeh- kên
verses.literal: therefore wisdom and knowledge have been granted to you And I will also give you riches and wealth and honor unlike . . . anything given to the kings before you or . . . . . . after you
verses.literalPt: Sabedoria e conhecimento te são dados; e te darei riquezas, bens e honra, quais não teve nenhum rei antes de ti, e nem depois de ti haverá.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה לַבָּמָ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־ בְּגִבְעוֹן֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם מִלִּפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō šə·lō·mōh lab·bā·māh ’ă·šer- bə·ḡiḇ·‘ō·wn yə·rū·šā·lim mil·lip̄·nê ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ way·yim·lōḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So Solomon went to Jerusalem from the high place in Gibeon from before the Tent of Meeting and he reigned over Israel
verses.literalPt: Assim Salomão veio a Jerusalém, do alto que estava em Gibeom, de diante da tenda da congregação; e reinou sobre Israel.

verses.original: וַיֶּאֱסֹ֣ף שְׁלֹמֹה֮ רֶ֣כֶב וּפָרָשִׁים֒ וַֽיְהִי־ ל֗וֹ אֶ֤לֶף וְאַרְבַּע־ מֵאוֹת֙ רֶ֔כֶב וּשְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וַיַּנִּיחֵם֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י הָרֶ֔כֶב וְעִם־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בִּירֽוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye·’ĕ·sōp̄ šə·lō·mōh re·ḵeḇ ū·p̄ā·rā·šîm way·hî- lōw ’e·lep̄ wə·’ar·ba‘- mê·’ō·wṯ re·ḵeḇ ū·šə·nêm- ‘ā·śār ’e·lep̄ pā·rā·šîm way·yan·nî·ḥêm bə·‘ā·rê hā·re·ḵeḇ wə·‘im- ham·me·leḵ bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Solomon accumulated - - 1,400 . . . . . . chariots and 12,000 . . . . . . horses which he stationed in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: E Salomão ajuntou carros e cavaleiros, e teve mil e quatrocentos carros, e doze mil cavaleiros; os quais pôs nas cidades dos carros, e junto ao rei em Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת־ הַכֶּ֧סֶף וְאֶת־ הַזָּהָ֛ב בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם כָּאֲבָנִ֑ים וְאֵ֣ת הָאֲרָזִ֗ים נָתַ֛ן כַּשִּׁקְמִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־ בַּשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה לָרֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ wə·’eṯ- haz·zā·hāḇ bî·rū·šā·lim kā·’ă·ḇā·nîm wə·’êṯ hā·’ă·rā·zîm nā·ṯan kaš·šiq·mîm ’ă·šer- baš·šə·p̄ê·lāh lā·rōḇ
verses.literal: The king made silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as stones and cedar as abundant as sycamore in the foothills
verses.literalPt: E fez o rei que houvesse ouro e prata em Jerusalém como pedras; e cedros em tanta abundância como sicômoros que há pelas campinas.

verses.original: וּמוֹצָ֧א הַסּוּסִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִשְׁלֹמֹ֖ה מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וּמִקְוֵ֕א סֹחֲרֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ מִקְוֵ֥א יִקְח֖וּ בִּמְחִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mō·w·ṣā has·sū·sîm ’ă·šer liš·lō·mōh mim·miṣ·rā·yim ū·miq·wê sō·ḥă·rê ham·me·leḵ miq·wê yiq·ḥū bim·ḥîr
verses.literal: Solomon’s . . . horses were imported from Egypt and Kue the royal merchants purchased them . . . from Kue
verses.literalPt: E os cavalos, que tinha Salomão, eram trazidos do Egito; e os mercadores do rei os recebiam em tropas, cada uma pelo seu preço.

verses.original: וַֽ֠יַּעֲלוּ וַיּוֹצִ֨יאוּ מִמִּצְרַ֤יִם מֶרְכָּבָה֙ בְּשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת כֶּ֔סֶף וְס֖וּס בַּחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמֵאָ֑ה וְ֠כֵן לְכָל־ מַלְכֵ֧י הַֽחִתִּ֛ים וּמַלְכֵ֥י אֲרָ֖ם בְּיָדָ֥ם יוֹצִֽיאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·lū way·yō·w·ṣî·’ū mim·miṣ·ra·yim mer·kā·ḇāh bə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ ke·sep̄ wə·sūs ba·ḥă·miš·šîm ū·mê·’āh wə·ḵên lə·ḵāl mal·ḵê ha·ḥit·tîm ū·mal·ḵê ’ă·rām bə·yā·ḏām yō·w·ṣî·’ū
verses.literal: A chariot could be imported . . . from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver and a horse for a hundred and fifty Likewise they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Aram
verses.literalPt: E faziam subir e sair do Egito cada carro por seiscentos siclos de prata, e cada cavalo por cento e cinqüenta; e assim, por meio deles eram para todos os reis dos heteus, e para os reis da Síria.
